name: random_graph_half
rationale: The upstream adaptive graph factors live in an unregistered Python list: they receive neither optimizer updates nor checkpoint persistence. Nevertheless, the GCN assigns substantial weight to their first and second random graph powers (input channels 320:448). This graph is unrelated to the supplied spatial adjacency. Halve those two channel groups while preserving the self and physical-graph terms. This tests whether the model has acquired excess reliance on random spatial mixing; it is a hypothesis, not an assumed correction. Select exclusively on calibration and reject if confirmation does not support it.
